quote: We evaluate models based on whether test sites are segmented correctly... We define the paradigm accuracy... The overall accuracy... We define the paradigm accuracy of a sentiment analysis model... The overall accuracy of a model on ERAS is the mean of that model's paradigm accuracies across all paradigms.
A sample of 20 sentence pairs from each paradigm was evaluated by 5 native speakers of Mandarin Chinese... Annotators were asked to rank sentence triples in order of sentiment polarity.
guideline: Annotators ranked sentence triples based on sentiment polarity (most positive to most negative).
